description: This file contains code and markdown cells for a project that uses Langchain, OpenAI API, and SQLAlchemy to generate SQL queries from natural language questions, execute them on a PostgreSQL database, and generate detailed answers based on the retrieved data. It includes setup code, prompt templates, SQL query extraction, data retrieval functions, and example usage with a user question.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt combining user question and additional instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAI chat completion request with a specific task prompt and user query, returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts the SQL query enclosed between ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL query against the database and returns fetched results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL query, data, and table descriptions.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates estimated token-based cost for input and output data for OpenAI API usage.
